text:
dave: heads-up — deploy-bot failed the regional image promotion for eu-west-1, push to our registry returned 401 token_expired. promotion is blocked

deploy-bot: automated: push failed for service/payments:v2.4.1 -> registry.internal/eu-west-1: 401 Unauthorized (token expired)

maria: how widespread is this? only eu-west-1 or other regions too?

jamie: i see successful pulls in us-west and ap-south earlier, looks like only the eu token rotated and CI didnt pick it up

sre-ops: registry team rotated ephemeral tokens ~8m ago as part of rolling KMS key rotation, some ephemeral creds didn't refresh for long-lived jobs

linda: ok — quick options: 1) retry promotion now after forcing a token refresh in the pipeline, 2) skip eu-west and continue other regions (partial promotion), 3) mirror image from us-west to eu registry if network policy allows

miguel: option 3 requires cross-registry mirror job and will take ~4-6m, but keeps the release consistent across regions

dave: preference is to avoid partial releases unless risk acceptable. any automated fallback configured?

deploy-bot: note: current promotion run has --strict-registry-check enabled. there is an override flag `--allow-partial` to continue despite one-region push failure. (requires approver)

jamie: we should avoid --allow-partial for payments. can we trigger a token refresh and re-run the promotion pipeline? who can run that?

sre-ops: i can run the rotation-retry job that refreshes ephemeral creds for the promotion runner. will do now and report back

(deploy-bot): re-run queued at 6012345742 by sre-ops

sre-ops: re-run failed again, different error: 403 forbidden when writing image manifest — looks like registry IAM propagation lag after rotation

linda: that propagation lag is the risk. mirror plan still looks safest even if slightly slower. miguel, ok to kick off mirror job?

miguel: on it, kicking mirror -> `kubectl run image-mirror --image=registry.internal/us-west/service/payments:v2.4.1 -- /mirror --dest registry.internal/eu-west-1/service/payments:v2.4.1` (pseudo)

dave: update release notes to mention delayed eu rollout and that eu will follow within the hour, also note remediation steps and who approved mirror approach

maria: adding release-notes owner: jamie, and tagging legal/compliance for cross-registry copy: @legal-team (FYI)

deploy-bot: mirror completed successfully at 6012345888, promotion resumed for eu-west-1 and succeeded

dave: great. postmortem: add a short runbook step to detect ephemeral token rotations and restart promotion runners automatically, and consider reducing strict race window. tagging @sre-ops for follow-up

sre-ops: will add runbook entry and a small automation to refresh creds on promotion start. thanks all

maria: :thumbsup: good call — will update release notes and close the thread
